pages.title: Omakase
pages.text: Calamari over cooked rice makes $(item)Kraken Nigiri$(). Flounder wrapped in kelp and rice makes the $(item)Flounder Roll$(). Both recipes serve two.

pages.title: The Gamble
pages.text: The $(item)Irukandji Roll$() is jellyfish sushi, prepared honestly: most bites are delicious, and roughly one in three remembers it used to be venomous. Order it anyway. Fortune favors the hungry.
